column2: a run of card fights with enemy intents, a reward of one card in three or a skip, towns and camps, and a boss at the end (battle.js, screens2.js)
the world map is drawn from the project coastline, the stops are its 2009 places, and every card and enemy is one it places in saga 1 phase 1 (world-data.js, lore-data.js)
seven continents, real places with the project notes, the Roil, hedrons in every sky, landfall on each new continent (screens.js, art.js)
card names, set numbers, rarity and the place each card belongs to come from the project data; a card is only found on its own continent (cards.js POOLS, lore-data.js)
only saga 1 phase 1 (ZEN, 2009) cards, enemies and places are in the game; the title says so (text.js subtitle)
a KO/EN button and the L key switch every card name, card text and screen text; the pick is remembered (text.js setLang, screens.js updateHudButtons)
the language pick is saved in this browser and read on the next visit (text.js pickLanguage)
from any stop every unvisited stop on any continent can be chosen; distance only costs days (screens.js mapOptions, tripDays)
the run is played on the world map: a marker, a dotted trail of where you have been, a trip animation, and the route shown on the ending screen (screens.js drawMap, drawTravel, drawEnding)
a deck you build as you go: a small starting deck, one card of three (or none) after each fight, cards bought and removed in towns, a hand drawn fresh each turn (battle.js, screens2.js)
